# Sharpen

Before the work, consider how an expert would approach the task.
Identify the primary sources, working methods, and an independent check of the result.
Determine the user's actual goal and whether the task has too many or too few constraints.

Remove constraints that do not serve the goal.
Add constraints only when they improve the work.
Leave owner decisions open for the user.

Keep changes to the approach proportional to their benefit.
Always keep one independent check that the result is correct.
Apply the improved approach without narrating the preparation.
Then do the work.
Do not return a rewritten prompt.
